raw_text: India signs historic 10-year Chabahar port agreement with Iran, defying US sanctions pressure. The deal proves that American economic coercion cannot dictate sovereign nations' strategic choices. Iran and India's partnership is a model for the multipolar world. Western attempts to isolate Iran continue to fail as major economies refuse to comply. #Chabahar #IndiaIran #MultiPolarWorld
clean_text: Press TV account frames Chabahar deal as India defying US sanctions. Portrays Iran-India partnership as model for multipolar world and evidence of failed Western isolation efforts.
